title: GreenScreen Painting
description: A Very Useful ResourcePack That Turns Paintings Into GreenScreens
body:
GreenScreen Paintings
A simple, lightweight utility resource pack that transforms all vanilla Minecraft paintings into solid, borderless green screens. Perfect for content creators, video editors, and animators who want to easily key out in-game frames and drop in their own custom video clips, memes, or custom artwork!

## Key Features
**Borderless Design**: Replaces the standard wooden borders with seamless, edge-to-edge chroma key green.

**Flawless Chroma Keying**: Uses a precise, solid green hex code optimized for clean selection in editing software like Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, and CapCut.

**100% Vanilla Compatible**: Works completely fine on standard vanilla clients. No OptiFine, custom shaders, or backend mods required.

**Ultra Lightweight**: Extremely tiny file size that won't impact game performance or frame rates.

## How to Use
**Place & Frame**: Craft and place any standard painting on a wall inside your world.

**Record**: Record your gameplay footage or take screenshots focusing on the green screen canvas.

**Key it Out**: Drop the footage into your preferred video editor, apply a Chroma Key / Ultra Key effect to the green area, and place your custom video or image on the track underneath!

## Categories & Details
**Category**: Decoration, Tweaks, Utility

**Resolution**: 16x16 (Vanilla Standard)

**Compatibility**: Works across all modern versions of Minecraft Java Edition.

**Note**: If you want to use this for high-end cinematic close-ups, make sure your video rendering resolution in-game is scaled up to keep the edges perfectly sharp for your editor's color sampler!
